objective: Classify the final eight sample-24 Walle background-prefix alpha bytes by comparing Apple's unmodified private main and shadow half sources with independently compiled custom stages from the same physical-Retina render.

decisionRule.privateCustomHalfSourcesExact: Apple source arithmetic is closed at sample 24; any Walle endpoint difference is an implementation replay boundary.
decisionRule.privateCustomHalfSourcesDiffer: Report the first unequal diagnostic stage and retain one Apple private-source unknown; do not claim parity.
decisionRule.transferOrLayerOutputDiffers: Retain a BGRA8 transfer unknown and do not claim parity.
decisionRule.missingOrVacuousEvidence: Fail closed and rerun without interpreting the artifact.

claimBoundary: This probe can classify the sample-24 source and transfer residual. It cannot by itself establish an end-to-end Walle frame, another material profile, another macOS build, or universal arbitrary-uniform emulation.
